decisions.reason: The custom earmold for in-ear systems builds directly on the firm's long-standing earmold materials, ear-impression and digital manufacturing know-how, so it can read early market feedback and improve the product in-house, even though its low web visibility signals a smaller commitment.

The individual in-ear earsleeve for universal hearing systems is a core application of the firm's earmold expertise, certified medical-device processes and hearing-care customer relationships, and its dedicated page shows the firm is actively investing in and learning from it.

The vacuum thermoforming unit extends the firm's established dental lab equipment and foil-materials system, where its in-house R&D and integrated-workflow know-how allow it to refine the device and sell it together with its consumables.
